functions.name: CFE_PSP_Exception_WriteComplete
functions.purpose: Marks the most recently written exception log entry as complete by incrementing the write counter, and preemptively invalidates the 'context_id' of the next buffer slot to prevent stale data from being read if another exception occurs during a log write.
functions.why: After an exception is captured into the exception storage buffer, the application must be notified that a new entry is available. Incrementing NumWritten is the synchronization mechanism. The preemptive zeroing of the next entry's context_id serves as a protective measure against a race condition: because exceptions cannot be locked out, a second exception could overwrite or corrupt the buffer while a log file write is in progress. Invalidating the next slot's ID reduces the chance that the application will read a partially written or inconsistent entry.
